title: Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures
abstract: arXiv:2610.21452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human face-to-face conversation requires coordinating speech, gestures and expressions across both speaking and listening. We present ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation. An autoregressive, chunk-wise synthesizer combines pretrained acoustic features with distinct listening and speaking hidden states from the dialogue backbone and speech synthesizer, enabling continuous non-verbal generation even when the model is verbally silent. To translate dialogue understanding into vivid semantic gestures, we introduce contextual semantic calls and template guidance, separating whether to invoke an available semantic gesture from how to realize it. We also establish a curated data and evaluation pipeline for dialog-aware co-speech gesture generation and investigate reference-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as automatic judges. translated_title: 基于语音、表情与手势的全双工交互
translated_abstract: 人类面对面的对话需要在说话和倾听两种状态下协调语音、手势和表情。我们提出了ELLSA 2，一个端到端的全双工对话模型，能够联合优化语音交互与流式手势-表情生成。该自回归、分块式的合成器将预训练声学特征与来自对话主干和语音合成器的独立倾听和说话隐藏状态相结合，即使模型在言语上保持沉默时也能持续进行非语言生成。为了将对话理解转化为生动的语义手势，我们引入了上下文语义调用和模板引导机制，将“是否调用可用的语义手势”与“如何实现该手势”分离开来。我们还建立了一个面向对话感知的伴随语音手势生成的精选数据与评估流程，并研究了基于参考的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）作为自动评判工具。实验……
tldr: 提出ELLSA 2端到端全双工对话模型，联合优化语音交互与流式手势-表情生成，使说话与倾听过程中的语音、表情和手势得以协调，实现言语沉默时仍能持续进行非语言表达。
en_tdlr: ELLSA 2, an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model, jointly optimizes speech interaction and streaming gesture-expression generation, enabling coordinated speech, expressions, and gestures during both speaking and listening, with continuous non-verbal generation even when verbally silent.
